description: Low-level hardware I/O routines for PowerPC architecture, providing inline functions for port I/O operations, in-/out- functions for different data sizes and endianness, using inline assembly for direct hardware access.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the specified hardware address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified hardware address using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit big-endian value to the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to the hardware address via inline assembly.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Issues a memory barrier with 'sync' instruction to ensure order of memory operations.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Issues an 'eieio' instruction for ordering I/O operations on PowerPC CPUs.

methods.name: void barrier(void)
methods.description: Provides a compiler memory barrier to prevent reordering of instructions.

ctags.name: out_8
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_8(volatile uint8_t *addr, uint8_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_be16
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_be16(volatile uint16_t *addr, uint16_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_be32
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_be32(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_le16
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_le16(volatile uint16_t *addr, uint16_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_le32
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_le32(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val)$/
